items.docs: Fields and Child relationships can be specified (e.g., giving created jobs the same job tags or allocations). By default, required Job fields like Region ID and duration will be propagated even if not specified.

info.name: Update jobs in a recurring schedule

items.docs: Updates the fields and attached objects of jobs in a recurring schedule, where the jobs start at or after the provided timestamp. Arrays of attached 'HasMany' objects can be provided along with the fields to be updated. In this case, all existing attached objects of the same type on future jobs will be deleted and replaced with the provided objects.
